title: show: resolve concept names without .md, stay inside the bundle
summary: Specified: show takes names without .md (exact file, else name.md) read from the bundle root, leading / or not (OKF 0.2; Windows \ stays drive-rooted); a directory is Concept not found; paths and symlinks leaving the bundle refused (exit 2). New CORE-010; fix, 0.18.2. Issue 56.
